# P34.14 — Jurisdiction display names (interim)

**Requirement ids:** none named by the plan row; the rules applied are plan
§5.1 (**TS-03**, **TS-10**, **TS-12**) and G2 §6's claim rules ·
**Findings closed:** **F-105** (S1 — jurisdictions shown only as bare
codes; place-name searches return 0 though dossiers exist) · QW-8 (K15
§3.7.1), K4 NEW-1 ·
**Base:** `r11/P34.13-chrome-format-accessibility-quick-fixes` (chain tip —
merge after it) ·
**Ticket:**
`docs/tickets/216_P34.14__jurisdiction-display-names-interim.md`
(manifest row 216 — Round 11 / P34, sub-round 11A) ·
**Live stage:** **none** — code + copy + tests only; the public effect
rides P34.17's republish #1 under its own verbatim go.
`live_verification=false`.

## Why

Every public surface printed the `jurisdiction` wire field raw: dossier
titles and H1s read "Surveillance infrastructure — AL", the dossier index
and the landing reach list showed bare "AL"/"AU-QLD" cells, and the
search index's labels and sublabels were codes — so typing "Alabama"
found nothing even though the dossier existed (F-105). Two codes are
*physically* mixed buckets — `ID` is asserted under `us.state_abbr`
(Idaho) and `iso.3166_1_alpha2` (Indonesia), `MN` under `us.state_abbr`
(Minnesota) and ISO (Mongolia) — and naming either one would quietly lie
about which place the dossier covers until JUR-05's split pages exist.

## What this does

1. **The interim lookup (`web/src/lib/jurisdictions.ts`).** A deterministic
   `JURISDICTION_NAMES` table — code → place name — covering every code
   the connector registry can emit (all `us.state_abbr` values incl. DC +
   territories, the emitted ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 and ISO 3166-2 codes, and
   `unresolved`), plus `JURISDICTION_COMBINES` for the two physically
   mixed buckets. `displayJurisdiction()` returns name / code /
   `Name (CODE)` label / combines pair / `known` flag; values already
   name-form (the fixture dossiers) pass through untouched; a bare code
   the table does not know fails loud as **"Unspecified jurisdiction
   (CODE)"** with `known: false` — never a guessed name. The names are
   code↔name facts from the schemes the registry declares (USPS
   abbreviations, ISO 3166-1/-2) — the derived-facts basis (ADR-085/086);
   no third-party expression is copied, and `check:licenses` passes
   (no new dependency).
2. **Names lead everywhere a person reads a jurisdiction.** Dossier
   `<title>`/`<h1>`/jurisdiction line and the print form's title/H1
   (`dossierDisplayTitle` rewrites the subject label's trailing
   " — `CODE`" to " — `Name (CODE)`"); the dossier index shows
   `Name (CODE)` and now sorts by the name a reader browses; the search
   island's dossier labels and both dossier/site sublabels carry
   `Name (CODE)`; the landing "Jurisdiction reach" list matches.
   Wire fields are untouched — `jurisdiction`, `subject_label`, slugs,
   `data-*` keys and the `[slug].json` wire form keep the bare code.
3. **The mixed buckets say what they combine (K4 NEW-1).** On the ID and
   MN dossiers (and their print forms) a new sentence renders the two
   places: "This dossier combines Idaho (US) and Indonesia." / "…Minnesota
   and Mongolia." — copy rows **JD-01/JD-02**, `pending`. It renders only
   inside the `combines` guard, so a non-mixed dossier can never claim
   one; the ID/MN display name itself is the honest combined name
   ("Idaho (US) and Indonesia (ID)").
4. **The unmapped-code flag (AC5).** When a code the table does not know
   reaches any of the five name surfaces, the page also shows the flag —
   "A jurisdiction code SIG has not yet named is on this page — flag it in
   the research queue." (rows **JD-03…JD-07**, `pending`, research-queue
   task link). No emitted code triggers it today; the row pins the
   sentence shape.
5. **Copy batch (B-2).** Seven rows appended `pending` to batch-01 with
   sha256s; `data-copy` attributes bind the elements; the P34.11 binding
   test's id pattern and page map extended (`JD`, `/search/`).
6. **The release search index is recorded, not changed.** The
   per-compartment FTS5 index in release bytes
   (`exports/src/exports/search_index.py` — `records.jurisdiction`,
   `facets("jurisdiction")`) keys on the spine's bare codes; naming those
   is an exporter change that lands with the re-export and rides
   republish #2 (P34.21b) — recorded, never silently half-renamed.

## Test plan

- `web/tests/unit/jurisdictions.test.ts` (new, 13 tests) — the table
  covers every `state=` code the committed registry TOML emits; no mapped
  name is itself a bare code; label shape; ID/MN pairs and labels;
  `unresolved` fallback; unmapped-code fail-loud + `known: false`;
  `dossierDisplayTitle` rewrites only a trailing code suffix; the JD-01/02
  sentence expands to the recorded ID/MN wordings.
- `web/tests/e2e/jurisdiction-names.nojs.spec.ts` (new, 3 tests) — every
  dossier-index place cell and landing reach cell is a name, not a bare
  code; the index cell equals the linked dossier's jurisdiction line and
  no dossier H1 ends in a bare code; a non-mixed dossier ships no
  combines/unmapped note.
- `web/tests/e2e/jurisdiction-names.spec.ts` (new, 2 tests) — search
  result sublabels are names, not bare codes; a typed place name finds
  the dossier (F-105).
- `tests/unit/test_p34_14_jurisdiction_names.py` (new, 6 tests) — the
  table covers every emitted code; the ID/MN combines pairs are the
  recorded verbatim ones; JD-01…JD-07 exist pending + hash-pinned on
  their pages; the combines elements sit behind the `combinesList` guard;
  every name surface consumes the lookup; the wire layer keeps the code.
- Export-mode build verified over `exports/out/national` (131 pages):
  index cells render `Alabama (AL)`…`Idaho (US) and Indonesia (ID)`,
  `Minnesota and Mongolia (MN)`, `Unresolved jurisdiction`; ID/MN pages
  carry the combines sentence on HTML and print forms; no unmapped flag
  fires. Fixture mode unchanged (name-form pass-through).

## Boundaries / notes

- **No production mutation, no republish.** `live_verification=false`;
  the public effect rides P34.17's republish #1.
- **Codes stay.** The wire contract (`jurisdiction`, `subject_label`,
  slugs, `jurisdictionCode` adapter key, JSON) is untouched; the display
  layer names the place — nothing re-exports, nothing renames.
- **Copy stays `pending`.** JD-01…JD-07 are agent-drafted rows; only
  `confirmed` copy ships, so republish #1 stays gated on the operator's
  verbatim confirmation. The `{combinesList}` placeholder is recorded
  verbatim (the HW-09 denominator precedent); it resolves to
  "Idaho (US) and Indonesia" / "Minnesota and Mongolia".
- **Interim by design.** JUR-05's split pages supersede the combines
  sentence; the FTS5 record/facet names are P34.21b's re-export; the
  map/research-queue/watch surfaces' own code fields stay as-is for their
  owning rows — this row names only the surfaces its contract lists
  (titles/H1s, dossier index, search index, and the landing reach list
  that renders the same dossier pair).
- **Append-only.** batch-01 only gained rows; no protected record
  touched until closeout.
